definitions.explanation: the physical sensation of needing water; a parched throat
a strong desire or yearning for something

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{渇|かわ}き (thirst)
- {渇|かわ}きを⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧/⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to feel thirsty)
- {渇|かわ}きを⟦{潤|うるお}す→潤す：08249_uruosu⟧/⟦{癒|いや}す→癒す：13616_iyasu⟧ (to quench one's thirst)
- 〜⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{渇|かわ}き (a thirst/craving for ~)

WATCH OUT:
{渇|かわ}き and {乾|かわ}き sound the same. {渇|かわ}き is thirst, of the body or the heart; dryness of air, laundry, or paint is {乾|かわ}き (from ⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧) or ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧. So ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧, not ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{渇|かわ}き.
